_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment. Sourced 2026-07-03 (pilot batch S7). Represents the current BabyZen/Stokke YOYO (YOYO3); Clek lists YOYO+/YOYO²/YOYO³ as one entry. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: BabyZen YOYO3 (covers YOYO+ / YOYO² / YOYO³)

clekListed.clekRow: Stokke/BABYZEN YOYO+ / YOYO² / YOYO³ — YOYO car seat adapters (BZ10205-03)

specs._weightNote: YOYO3 frame 6.7 kg / 14.8 lb; the prior YOYO2 was ~13.6 lb.
specs._dimsNote: YOYO3 published as 106 × 86 × 44 cm open and 52 × 44 × 18 cm folded; width 17.3 in (44 cm) is the signature single-hand cabin fold that fits airline overhead bins.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth with 0+ Newborn Pack; 6 mo+ with 6+ seat

safety.standards: US federal stroller standard 16 CFR 1227 / ASTM F833-19

recall.summary: Stokke recalled ~2,890 YOYO3 strollers (CPSC recall 25-044, Nov 14 2024): the parking brake can disengage, posing an injury hazard. Affects YOYO3 units with serial numbers beginning '142AA' below '0062239'; remedy is a full refund. Earlier YOYO+/YOYO2 models are not included in this recall.

safety.notes: 5-point harness; multi-position recline; padded shoulder carry strap. This fragment represents the current YOYO3, which is the generation covered by the Nov 2024 brake recall.

specs.foldType: one-hand compact fold, self-standing, airline-cabin approved
specs.tires: 5.9 in front / 7 in rear foam-filled; front swivel with suspension

notes: The archetypal light/compact city+shopping stroller and the strongest complement to the owned BOB Alterrain Pro. ~14.8 lb, one-hand cabin fold (20.5 × 17.3 × 7.1 in). JPMA Certified. Clek Liing attaches via the BabyZen YOYO adapter BZ10205-03 (adapter-bz10205-03) — note the older YOYO+ adapter variant does NOT list Clek, so the current BZ10205-03 is the right part. Best cited price $499 (Strolleria, YOYO3 6+ complete).
